# Darmi

> Darmi is a privacy-first iOS food and symptom tracker for people living with IBS
> (irritable bowel syndrome). It turns meals and symptoms into visible patterns and
> into structured data you can bring to a doctor. There is no account, no login and
> no server — everything is stored on the user's own device.

- **Website:** https://darmi.app/
- **Download:** https://apps.apple.com/us/app/darmi-ibs-food-symptom-tracker/id6759197247
- **Platform:** iOS
- **Price:** Freemium. Free to download and free to use; an optional Pro upgrade is
  available as a monthly, yearly or lifetime in-app purchase. See "Free vs Pro" below.
- **App Store rating:** 4.7 stars from 18 ratings (snapshot: 2026-08-02)
- **Contact:** darmi.feedback@gmail.com

## What it tracks

Four entry types, and only these four: **meals, symptoms, stool type, and stress.**
Stool is recorded on the Bristol Stool Scale and feeds the analysis directly (types 1–2
read as constipation, types 6–7 as diarrhea). Darmi does **not** track mood.

## What it does

- **Fast logging.** Quick Picks learn the foods you eat most and surface them as
  one-tap shortcuts. Anything new can be typed in seconds — there is no bloated food
  database to search through. Swipe any entry to delete it.
- **Symptom, stool and stress tracking.** Symptoms, stool type on the Bristol Stool
  Scale and stress are captured in a single flow. Suitable for people tracking
  IBS-C (constipation-predominant), IBS-D (diarrhea-predominant) and IBS-M (mixed).
- **Trigger identification.** IBS symptoms often appear hours or days after the food
  that caused them. The Key Findings on the home screen work at the level of whole
  days: they compare how often a food appears on days with symptoms against how often
  it appears on days without, so a food has to recur on the bad days to surface.
  Separately, opening an individual symptom shows what was eaten in the six hours
  before it started; the same six-hour window backs the Tolerated Foods list.
- **Pattern insights.** Symptom trends over a rolling 7-day window on the free tier,
  extending to 14 and 30-day windows with Pro, so you can see whether a change you
  made is actually working.
- **Calendar view.** A month view of everything logged, at a glance.
- **Streak feedback.** Encouraging cards when you keep a logging streak going.
- **Doctor-ready export.** A structured, chronological PDF history of everything
  logged, ready to share at an appointment.

## Free vs Pro

Free tier includes unlimited logging of all four entry types, the 7-day insight
window, and one PDF export per calendar month.

The optional Pro upgrade (monthly, yearly or lifetime in-app purchase) unlocks:

1. Unlimited PDF exports (free tier is capped at one per calendar month).
2. The 14-day and 30-day insight windows.
3. The full set of Key Findings and Tolerated Foods entries — some are locked on free.
4. Custom symptoms.

## Privacy model

- No account to create, no sign-up, no login.
- No cloud sync and no servers in the current version. Data lives in the device's
  local database (IndexedDB in browsers).
- Works fully offline.
- No advertising SDKs.
- Full policy: https://darmi.app/privacy.html

## Languages

English, Deutsch, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, Français, Español, Português.

## Important limitation

Darmi is a tracking and pattern-analysis app. It is **not** a diagnostic tool or a
medical device, and it is not a substitute for professional medical advice. It does
not diagnose IBS or any other condition — it organizes information so a user and
their healthcare provider can discuss it.
